svg.title: Title-Side Fee Hygiene
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-title-side-fee-hygiene; chapter number: 4; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Title-Side Fee Hygiene; subtitle: What title bills, what it costs, and what an operator can claw back; caption: Rick treats the lien search as highly negotiable and asks for the reissue credit on every double close; Jerry Norton locks the cash buyer with a $5,000 non-refundable deposit.; assumptions note: Buckets are independent line items, not a summed closing statement. The reissue credit range applies the 50 to 55% discount to the $2,000 policy example.; note: Attributed to Rick (Flip With Rick) and Jerry Norton (Flipping Mastery TV).; total range: $50 to $5,000 per line item on a $25,000 assignment deal; buckets: label: Lien search actual title cost; low: 50; high: 100; notes: Rick keeps the written report in every file as proof if liens surface later.; label: Lien search as billed; low: 75; high: 250; notes: The gap over actual cost is the negotiating room.; label: Reissue credit on a $2,000 policy; low: 1000; high: 1100; notes: 50 to 55% off the second-side policy, offered only when asked.; label: Cash buyer non-refundable deposit; low: 5000; high: 5000; notes: Posted at title on a $206,000 contract assigned at $231,000.
